summary_en: Shin-Etsu Chemical authorized acquisition of up to 10 million shares (0.55% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 50 billion yen from November 16, 2026 through April 27, 2027, via open market purchase or block trades.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Shin-Etsu Chemical's board of directors on November 13, 2026 resolved to acquire treasury stock based on the Company Law Article 165(3). The acquisition framework permits purchase of up to 10 million shares with an aggregate limit of 50 billion yen. This represents 0.55% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026, when the company held 169.26 million treasury shares against a total of 1.816 billion outstanding shares. The acquisition period runs from November 16, 2026 through April 27, 2027.

The company stated that this acquisition continues its capital policy that emphasizes return on equity and cost of capital considerations. The authorization supplements 25 billion yen in treasury acquisitions already executed in the current fiscal year. The company applies a fundamental policy of expanding operating earnings through financial discipline and returning the results to shareholders appropriately and stably. Share repurchases are executed opportunistically in response to stock price levels and other circumstances, as part of comprehensive shareholder returns managed within a total payout ratio framework.

The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases and block trades. No ceiling price per share was specified in the disclosure.
